Commentary.Commentary: Pat Cummins is handed over the trophy and he celebrates the victory along with his teammates. Right then! That is it from this exuberant Test series! Australia has all the momentum as we now move to white-ball cricket. The three-match ODI series will begin on Tuesday, 29th March with the first ball to be bowled at 3:30 pm IST (10:00 am GMT). But as usual, the build-up will begin much earlier. Do join us for the same. Till then, it is goodbye from this side.

Pat Cummins, the skipper of Australia is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for picking up a total of 8 wickets in the Test match. He says that it was fantastic the way they batted in the first innings and put themselves ahead in the game, and he thought 350 was a good enough target on this wicket. Mentions that the initial wickets were tough to get but once the ball was old and it started reversing it got better to take wickets. Adds that he is really happy with everyone's performance, and he is happy for Swepson as well, who was a key bowler for them. Concludes by saying that they have been well received in Pakistan and it has been a wonderful experience.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says that it was a great series. Adds that his side gave a good fight tthroughout the series but weren't good enough in the last two sessions on Day 5 of the third Test. Tells that they lost back-to-back wickets in the second session and that cost them. Mentions that they showed great character in the first two Tests but failed to get over the line in Lahore. He applauds the Australian team for the win and also thanks them for coming over to Pakistan after 24 years.

Usman Khawaja is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for scoring 496 runs across three Tests! He says that they had a lot of fun playing in Pakistan, and he thanks all the Pakistani fans for showing all the support. He says that they have come a long way to play in Pakistan and it was fun. Mentions that they had a target of 350 in mind, as it was tough once the ball started reversing a bit and was confident of his side taking 10 wickets in four sessions. Concludes by saying that he felt that hundred in the last innings was one of the hardest hundreds he has scored.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Pakistan conceded 391 runs with the ball in the first innings but their batters got them off to a great start as well. Abdullah Shafique, Azhar Ali and Babar Azam made some vital contributions but they completely fell apart when Pat Cummins and Mitchell Starc had their tail up with a relatively old ball. They lost wickets in quick succession and conceded a lead of 123 runs in the first innings. In the end, they were set a target of 351 and they did start well on Day 4, thanks to their openers, Abdullah Shafique and Imam-ul-Haq. However, apart from Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq, none of their batters managed to get in and score big and that cost them. Mohammad Rizwan didn't review when he was adjudged LBW and had he sent it upstairs, things could have been different for Pakistan. But having said that, Australia was just too good for Pakistan in this Test and they deserved to win this Test as well as the series.

Australia have dominated this Test match and they have justified their decision of declaring much earlier on Day 4. It was a combined effort from their batting department which set the tone for them in the first innings. Although, they were under the pump with the ball in the first innings, as Pakistan was cruising along at 248/3. But the duo of Mitchell Starc and Pat Cummins came roaring back and ensured that Australia get a handy lead in the first innings. Pakistan lost 7 wickets for just 20 runs and that proved to be the turning point in this Test. The Aussies piled on more runs with the bat in the second innings and it was Usman Khawaja who brought up his second century of the Test series. Australia set a target of 351 for Pakistan and their bowlers gave it their all on Day 5. The GOAT, Nathan Lyon grabbed a five-fer, which also included the prized scalp of Babar Azam. It was Pat Cummins who wrapped things up for his side and he finished with three wickets to his name.

WOW! What an end to this enthralling Test series. Australia are touring Pakistan after 24 long years, and they won the Benaud-Qadir Trophy 1-0. After a couple of draws at Rawalpindi and Karachi, Australia has managed to come out on top in Lahore. They have completely outclassed the hosts and the No.1 ranked Test side thoroughly deserves to win this three-match series. Pakistan would be proud of the way they played throughout the series but disappointed at the end of this game, as their openers toiled hard on Day 4 but they never looked like chasing down the target after losing Abdullah Shafique early on in the first session on Day 5.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! AUSTRALIA HAVE WON IN PAKISTAN! Pat Cummins brings himself into the attack and finishes things off in style! We finally have a result after 15 hard days of intense Test cricket. Coming to the ball - This was on a length, around middle, a straight delivery. Naseem Shah stays in the crease and looks to defend this but he misses and the ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Australia win by 115 runs!
Pat Cummins (15-6-23-2) brings himself into the attack.
On the pads, full in length. Nauman Ali works it away towards David Warner at short leg who collects the ball on the bounce.
Spinning in, around middle. Nauman Ali hangs back and blocks it out.
Loopy ball, around the leg pole. Nauman Ali defends it just away from the fielder at short leg.
Outside off, full, loopy delivery. Naseem Shah leans to block this, but the ball goes off the outside edge away from Steven Smith at first slip and towards third man. Single taken!
An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! A fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Naseem Shah stays in the crease and looks to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge onto his pads.
Spinning in, shorter ball, around off. Naseem Shah defends it out off the back foot.
Tad shorter, on middle. Nauman Ali defends it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Nauman Ali blocks it out.
Outside off, full in length. Nauman Ali leans and drives it towards cover.
Fuller, outside off. Nauman Ali defends it out.

Two byes! Lovely delivery! That has missed everything! A loopy ball, spinning in, around middle and off. Nauman Ali leans to defend but he gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes over the middle pole and Alex Carey fails to grab the ball as well. It rolls behind towards fine leg and the batters steal in two byes!
Shorter ball, spinning in, outside off. Nauman Ali defends it out.
Tad shorter, around middle. Naseem Shah blocks it out solidly.
Full again, outside off. Naseem Shah leans and defends it out.
Beaten! Fuller ball, outside off, much straighter. Naseem Shah looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a terrific catch in the deep from Mitchell Swepson and Nathan Lyon bags a five-wicket haul. His second against Pakistan in Test cricket. Excellent effort from the GOAT and Pakistan lose their ninth wicket now. Lyon tosses it up, around off. Shaheen Afridi kneels and looks to slog-sweep it way over the deep square leg region. He miscues it to the left of Swepson in the deep who runs to his left, bends low and takes a really good catch. Naseem Shah is the last batter in. The Aussies are ecstatic and they get around Nathan Lyon to applaud him.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Swepson b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker, around middle. Shaheen Afridi rocks back in his crease and dabs it onto the deck.
This is bowled slower through the air, on a length, around leg. Shaheen Afridi keeps it out.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Shaheen Afridi clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
A full ball, way down leg. Shaheen Afridi misses his flick and the ball goes through to Alex Carey behind the sticks.
FOUR! BOOM! That is absolutely hammered by Shaheen Afridi! Starc bowls it full and outside off. Shaheen sits back and smashes it past the diving fielder at mid off for a cracking boundary.
Well bowled! Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Shaheen Afridi squeezes it out.
Another length delivery, outside off. Nauman Ali guides it past point for a single.
On a length, shaping away, outside off. Nauman Ali leaves it alone.

OUT! BOWLED! Oh, dear! Hasan Ali gets deceived by the turn and bounce here and that brings about his downfall of him. Lyon gets his man and Pakistan lose another wicket, their eighth to be precise. Lyon tosses this one up, well outside off. Hasan Ali looks to slog-sweep but he mistimes it completely and is a bit too early into his shot. He misses, the ball spins sharply and hits Hasan's helmet. It then ricochets off his glove and disturbs the stumps. Australia are just 2 wickets away from a series win. Shaheen Afridi walks out to bat now.
A loopy ball, on a length, outside off. Hasan Ali stretches forward and defends it.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Hasan Ali blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! Hasan Ali brings out the reverse-sweep this time! This is tossed up, outside off. Hasan kneels and reverse-sweeps it behind square on the off side for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! That came out of nowhere! Lyon serves a loopy ball, well outside off. Hasan Ali gets under it and dispatches it well over the long off fence for a maximum.
Tossed up delivery, outside off. Hasan Ali prods and defends it solidly.
A low full toss, around middle. Hasan Ali clips it wide of mid on and takes a single. He will retain the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Hasan Ali lets it sail through to the keeper.
Good-length delivery, around off. Hasan Ali blocks it to the off side.
On a length, around middle. Hasan Ali tucks it to mid-wicket.

Another ball, full and outside off. Hasan Ali looks to dig it out. It takes the outside edge and runs away past the slip cordon. Mitchell Swepson at deep backward point, runs across to his left and keeps it to just two by diving to his left.
A full ball, well outside off. Hasan Ali lets it be.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Nauman Ali defends it solidly. A maiden over from Nathan Lyon!
A wayward ball, down leg. Nauman Ali does not bother playing at that one.
Floated, on a length, around middle. Nauman Ali defends it off the front foot.
Lyon comes over the wicket now and serves it on a length, around leg. Nauman Ali gets forward to block but he misses and gets hit on his front pad.
Floated, full and outside off. Nauman Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Flatter ball, around off. Nauman Ali defends it towards point.

NOT OUT! A huge appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Hasan Ali tries to dig this one out but he misses. Australia opt for a review after the umpire says no. UltraEdge shows that there is a gap between bat and ball. Hasan Ali survives and Australia lose their last review. A wicket-maiden from Mitchell Starc!
Outside off, shaping away, on a length. Hasan Ali leaves it alone.
A full ball, angling down leg, from 'round the wicket. Hasan Ali misses his flick and Alex Carey does well behind the sticks to grab it by diving to his left.
A short ball, angling in from outside off. Hasan Ali sways away from the line of the ball.
On a length, around off. Hasan Ali blocks it.
Hasan Ali is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Mitchell Starc gets rid of Sajid Khan who was looking well settled at the crease. He grabs his first wicket and Pakistan have lost their 7th wicket now. The hosts are falling apart here. A fuller ball, angling in, around middle. Sajid Khan flicks this but he was a bit early on his shot and ends up chipping it towards Usman Khawaja at mid-wicket. He pouches it safely and Sajid Khan walks back now. Australia are just 3 wickets away from a historic series win.
Commentary.Howout: c Usman Khawaja b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and around off. Nauman Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Flighted ball, outside off. Nauman Ali blocks it off the front foot.
Lyon serves a loopy full toss, around off. Nauman Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
Nauman Ali walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That's the wicket Australia were looking for and there is absolute silence at the Gaddafi stadium as Babar Azam walks back. Nathan Lyon strikes and grabs his third wicket. Pakistan are now 6 down. Australia do have this game in their pocket now. Coming to the ball - This was a full ball, much straighter on this occasion. Babar Azam leans to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards first slip. Steven Smith there, who has dropped a few earlier, holds on to this one. He takes a sharp low catch towards his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, tad fuller. Sajid Khan opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point for a single.
Flatter ball, full, around off. Sajid Khan defends it out.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Classy from Babar Azam! Pitches it up, outside off. Babar Azam leans and drives it straight down the ground for a glorious boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off, at 144 clicks. Babar Azam leaves it alone.
Pitches it up, outside off, at around 144 clicks. Babar Azam pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Angling in, on middle, on a length. Babar Azam blocks it out solidly.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off, shaping away. Babar Azam stays in his crease and tries to cut this away, but he misses.
FOUR! Sajid Khan is on the charge here! Loopy ball, full, outside off. Sajid Khan drives it past cover for a boundary.
On middle, fuller ball. Sajid Khan presses forward and defends it out.
Full again, outside off. Sajid Khan prods forward and taps it towards point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sajid Khan leans and drives it towards cover.
Floated, full and outside off. Sajid Khan defends it solidly.
Tossed up, on off. Sajid Khan keeps it out.

FOUR! Edged...and four! FIFTY for Babar Azam! Top innings from him, but he knows his job is only half done! A fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam leans and looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge past the second slip fielder for a boundary.

Bye! Down the leg side, tad shorter now. Sajid Khan looks to flick but he misses. Alex Carey dives and manages to get some glove onto the ball. The rolls towards fine leg. A bye taken! 200 up for Pakistan.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Full again, outside off this time. Sajid Khan leans and drives it past cover for another boundary.
FOUR! Wonderful shot! An overpitched delivery, very full, on the pads. Sajid Khan uses his wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
The second new ball has now been taken by Australia.
On a length, outside off. Babar Azam taps it towards point and gets across to the other end.
Angling in, full, around middle. Babar Azam tucks it towards mid-wicket.

We are back for the final session of this Test series. The players have made their way out to the middle. Babar Azam and Sajid Khan will resume their innings. Mitchell Starc will start proceedings with the ball.
... Day 5, Session 3 ...

The equation is quite simple, Australia need 5 wickets to win this game and clinch the series, while Pakistan need 161 runs from 37 overs. A win here for Pakistan seems highly unlikely but they will come out and try to save this Test. An exciting final session coming up, which is set to begin at 3:50 pm IST (10:20 am GMT). Stay tuned!

Nathan Lyon began the proceedings by grabbing the big wicket of Imam-ul-Haq. Pat Cummins followed it up and struck twice in two overs and sent back Fawad Alam and Mohammad Rizwan. Reverse-swing is doing the trick for the Aussies and with the new ball now due, it will be interesting to see whether the Aussies opt for it straightaway. Pakistan, on the flip side are in a spot of bother. Babar Azam is leading by example, but there is no support whatsoever from the other end. Although, Babar was also given a life when Travis Head dropped a catch, just at the stroke of Tea.

Three big wickets in the session and just 54 runs were given away, it's safe to say that the second session belonged to the visitors. Pakistan will be under pressure now since Babar Azam is probably their last recognized batter and they have an uphill task ahead of them.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Sajid Khan hangs back and taps it behind square on the off side. That will be Tea on Day 5!
On a length, around middle. Sajid Khan rides the bounce nicely and tucks it to the leg side.
Fraction short, outside off. Sajid Khan taps it wide of the slip fielder for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, outside off. Sajid Khan keeps it out.

DROPPED! That is a huge miss, Babar Azam survives! Lyon serves a loopy ball, around off. Babar Azam skips down the track and looks to go downtown. He tries to bring up his 50 with a biggie, but it goes off the inner half of his blade, in the air towards the mid-wicket region. Travis Head in the deep, doesn't pick it up at first, he reacts a bit late and drops it as he tries to catch it by diving forward. The batters take a run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Babar stays back and turns it to square leg.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Sajid Khan stays back and taps it towards cover.
Fuller in length, on middle. Khan prods and drives hard but finds the mid-wicket fielder this time.
This is a good-length delivery, angling in from middle. Sajid Khan wrists it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, around middle. Sajid Khan leans and drives it to the mid on fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Sajid Khan hangs back and defends it to the off side.
This is a length ball, around middle. Sajid Khan gets forward and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up, outside off. Babar Azam prods and defends it watchfully towards silly point.
Lyon sees Babar advancing down the track so he drags his length back and serves a quicker ball, around off. Babar keeps it out in the end.
Floated, full and outside off. Babar Azam stretches forward and defends it.
Plays it late this time! Flatter and quicker, outside off. Sajid Khan hangs back and guides it past the short third man fielder for a run.
Shorter in length and outside off. Sajid Khan sits back and dabs it onto the deck.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sajid Khan blocks it out.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Babar Azam is not going to miss out on these. This was short in length, width on offer. Babar Azam stands tall and punches it past cover for a boundary.
Pitches it up again, around middle, shaping in. Babar Azam pushes it towards mid on.
Another fuller ball, down the leg side again. Babar Azam misses his flick and Alex Carey dives and stops the ball this time.

FOUR BYES! Bonus runs for Pakistan! This one was a short ball, way down the leg side. Babar Azam leaves it alone. Alex Carey dives to his left and fails to get to the ball. The ball rolls towards fine leg for a boundary.
Angling in, around middle, fuller ball. Babar Azam flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full, outside off. Babar Azam leans and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, full again, around off. Sajid Khan presses forward and blocks it out.
Tad shorter, outside off. Babar Azam defends it towards point for a single.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam defends it out.
Fuller ball, on middle. Babar Azam leans and blocks it out.

A huge appeal for a catch, but the umpire is unmoved. A loopy ball, full, spinning in. Babar Azam leans to block this but the ball goes past his inside edge and hits his pad and lobs over the keeper's head. Steven Smith from first slip, dives to his left and takes a good catch. They decide not to go for the review in the end. The replays show that the ball was very close to Babar's glove and there was a slight murmer on the UltraEdge as the ball passed the glove. Had Australia reviewed this, it would have been curtains for Babar Azam.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Babar Azam leans and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Sajid Khan leans and defends it out.
Fraction shorter, down the leg side, at 127.2 clicks. Sajid Khan ducks under it and lets it go.
Full again, on middle. Sajid Khan flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Angling in around middle, on a length. Sajid Khan defends it out solidly.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On a length, angling in, around the thigh pads. Sajid Khan tickles it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller ball, swinging in, around middle. Sajid Khan flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Cameron Green (8-3-10-1) is back on.
Floated, full and outside off. Babar Azam defends it solidly off the front foot.

Lyon almost had his third wicket here! Flatter ball, around off and spinning in late. Sajid Khan gets forward to defend. It takes the thick inside edge and goes just past Marnus Labuschagne at short leg for a run.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Sajid Khan stretches forward and blocks it.
A bit quicker this time, around off. Sajid Khan keeps it out.
Sharp turn off the rough! Tossed up, way outside off and turning in sharply. Sajid Khan prods to drive but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
Tossed up, outside off. Babar Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to long on for a run.
Fuller in length, on off. Sajid Khan drives but straight to the mid on fielder.
A full ball, around middle. Sajid Khan gets forward and flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
A length ball, angling in from off. Sajid Khan covers the line and blocks it.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Babar Azam taps it towards backward point and rotates the strike.
Good-length ball, around off. Babar Azam keeps it out.
Full and outside off. Babar Azam drives it through covers and takes a couple of runs.
On a length, well outside off. Sajid Khan gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Flatter ball, on a length and staying a touch low. Sajid Khan rocks back and defends it.

A stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! This is tossed up, outside off and spinning in late. Sajid Khan prods to defend but he misses and gets hit on the pad. The ball pops out towards Steven Smith at first slip who grabs it.
Tossed up, around middle. Sajid Khan keeps it out.
Floated, full and outside off. Sajid Khan defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, outside off. Babar Azam pushes it towards point and takes a run.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sajid Khan defends it out. Another successful over by Pat Cummins!
Angling in, around middle, on a length. Sajid Khan pushes it towards mid on.
Beaten! Outside off, on a length, shaping away. Sajid Khan looks to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Sajid Khan comes to the crease now.

OUT! LBW! That is a peach of a delivery from the Aussie skipper and Mohammad Rizwan had absolutely no answers to that one. Huge, huge moment in this Test, and the Australians are pumped! Cummins runs in and serves a pinpoint yorker that angles in late. Rizwan is a bit late to react and he gets hit on his toe. Cummins appeals and the umpire agrees. Rizwan has a chat with his skipper but he doesn't opt for a review, he takes the long walk back to the pavilion. Although, the Ball Tracker shows that the impact was well outside off and had Rizwan taken the review he would be still out there in the middle. Nothing going Pakistan's way at the moment.
This is a full ball, jagging back in from outside off. Mohammad Rizwan skips down the track a bit and turns it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Babar Azam flicks it to deep square leg and takes a single.
Outside off, fuller length delivery. Mohammad Rizwan presses forward and looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside edge and falls just short of Steven Smith at first slip.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan lunges and defends it out.
Tad shorter, spinning in, outside off. Babar Azam pushes it towards cover. Single taken!
Loopy ball, full, around off. Babar Azam leans and blocks it out.
Turn and bounce for Lyon! Tuning in, slower through the air, around middle. Babar Azam stays back manages to fend it out towards short leg.
Loopy ball, very full, around off. Babar Azam pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery, around the sixth stump line. Mohammad Rizwan leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle, jagging back in. Mohammad Rizwan blocks it out.

DRINKS! Australia has got a couple of wickets in quick succession right after the Lunch break and they are clearly in the driver's seat at the moment. To add to that, Pakistan have a long tail and it is now up to their two talismanic players, Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan to see their side home. Australia look favorites from hereon though. Mohammad Rizwan walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! Pat Cummins brings himself into the attack and he strikes straightaway! Pakistan lose their fourth wicket and they are in some sort of trouble now! Pat Cummins serves this on a fuller length, around off, shaping away just a tad. Fawad Alam looks to dig it out but he plays down the wrong line and misses. The ball goes past his outside edge and hits him on the pad. The umpire raises his finger after an appeal for LBW from Australia. Fawad Alam opts for a review. The UltraEdge confirms no bat involved and the Ball Tracker shows three reds! Fawad Alam has to walk back. Pakistan lose a review as well.
Fuller ball from 'round the wicket, around middle, at around 136 clicks. Fawad Alam defends it out.
Another length delivery, tailing back in, on the thigh pads. Babar Azam flicks it past square leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, jagging back in, around middle. Babar Azam defends it out off the back foot.
Fuller, around the leg pole. Fawad Alam pushes it towards mid on.
Full again, pitching it outside the leg stump line. Fawad Alam presses forward and defends it out.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Babar Azam advances down the pitch and knocks it towards long on. Single taken!
Full again, spinning in, outside off. Babar Azam blocks it out towards David Warner at silly point.
Much straighter now, around middle and leg. Babar Azam stays in his crease and defends it out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam lunges forward and blocks it out.
Nipping back in around middle, on a length. Fawad Alam defends it out.
Swing and a miss! On a length shaping away, outside off. Fawad Alam looks to have a poke at it, but he misses.
Very full, angling in from over the wicket, around middle. Fawad Alam pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Pitches it up again, outside off, shaping away. Babar Azam pushes it with the outer half of his bat towards deep cover for a single.
Tad fuller again, shaping away, outside off. Babar Azam drives and finds the fielder at cover this time.
A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, outside off. Babar Azam pushes it past cover for two runs.
Short once again, around middle, spinning in. Babar Azam flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Turning in, around off, tad shorter. Babar Azam stays in his crease and cuts it towards cover-point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam lunges and defends it out.
Tad shorter, spinning away, around middle. Fawad Alam whips it past mid-wicket. Pat Cummins chases it and keeps the ball away from the ropes. Three taken!
Full, around off. Fawad Alam leans and defends it out.
Pitching it outside the line of leg stump, full. Fawad Alam hangs back and tucks it towards square leg.
Back of a length, outside off. Fawad Alam taps it to point and takes a quick run.

Inside edge saves Fawad Alam this time! Starc runs in and bowls it very full around off. The ball angles in late. Fawad Alam looks to dig it out but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. Australia appeal but the umpire is not interested. Pat Cummins though opts for a review but the UltraEdge confirms that there was a huge inside edge. The on-field decision stays. Australia burn their review.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Babar Azam steers it towards deep backward point and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Babar Azam hangs back and punches it towards extra cover.
This is darted on the pads. Alam tickles it fine through the fine leg region for a single.
A full ball, around middle. Fawad Alam stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.

Shorter in length, around middle. Babar flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length, around off. Babar Azam keeps it out.

FOUR! Streaky but Babar Azam will take that! This is a flatter ball, on a length, outside off and turning in late. Babar prods to defend. This time though he goes at it with hard hands. It takes the outside edge and flies past Steven Smith at first slip for a boundary. 150 comes up for Pakistan.
Floated, full and around off. Babar Azam covers the line and defends it with soft hands.
Flatter ball, around leg. Alam stays back and whips it off his pad. David Warner at short leg sticks his right hand out but fails to grab it. The ball rolls away towards mid-wicket for a single.
A full ball, angling in from outside off. Babar Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out.
Full and outside off. Babar Azam lets it sail through to the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Babar Azam hangs back and defends it.
Good-length delivery, angling in from off. Babar Azam gets forward and blocks it.
Another ball that is full and way outside off. Babar Azam lets it be.
Starc serves a full ball, outside off. Babar Azam lets it through to the keeper.
Tosses it up, full in length, around middle and leg. Fawad Alam lunges and blocks it out away from the fielder at short leg. A successful over from Nathan Lyon!
Tad shorter, turning away, around off. Fawad Alam blocks it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Top shot! Fawad Alam gets off the mark in style! A fuller, loopy delivery, on middle. Fawad Alam gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary!
Fuller ball, quicker, around the leg pole. Fawad Alam defends it towards square leg.
Fawad Alam walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lyon strikes straightaway after Lunch and this is a huge wicket for Australia! It is Imam-ul-Haq who has to walk back to the hut. Lovely bowling this from the GOAT and Pakistan find themselves in a spot of bother now. Lyon comes over the wicket and serves a flatter ball, on a length, around middle and spinning away late. Imam prods to block but it goes off the inside edge, onto the pad and the ball pops out towards Marnus Labuschagne at silly point who takes a sitter. Australia appeal and the umpire agrees. Imam opts for a review but the UltraEdge shows a clear spike as the ball passes the bat. Australia on top!
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: Lyon comes over the wicket and serves a flatter ball, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq stays back and keeps it out.
Who will bowl from the other end? Nathan Lyon, (21-6-42-1) it is!
Imam eases this full ball towards long on. He will retain the strike by taking a single.
ML bowls it slower through the air, full and outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it through the cover region and comes back for the second run.
Slightly shorter in length, on middle. Babar Azam rocks back and mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floated, full and well outside off. Imam-ul-Haq gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter ball, on a length, around leg. Babar Azam looks to defend but it goes off the thick inside edge towards square leg for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Babar Azam keeps it out.

We are back for the post-Lunch session! The players stride out to the middle. Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq will resume their innings. Marnus Labuschagne will begin with the ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
... Day 5, Session 2 ...

This Test match is evenly poised at the moment with all three results still possible. The second session will give us a fair idea about where this Test match is heading. Do join us for the middle session which begins at 2 pm IST (8.30 am GMT).

Australia started the session well and it was Cameron Green who struck early by sending back Abdullah Shafique with a peach of a delivery. Starc and Cummins also kept bowling tight lines and lengths and did not allow the batters to free their arms. Lyon spun the ball sharply and he got the prized scalp of Azhar Ali. For Pakistan, Imam-ul-Haq has held one end and he batted well. Although, he will need to bat deep and make sure that he stitches a big partnership along with his skipper. They still need 215 runs to win and they cannot afford to lose wickets heading into the latter stages of this Test match.

Another riveting session of this Test match comes to an end. Australia would be happier of the two sides going into Lunch as they have got those two crucial wickets. Although, Pakistan have managed to score 63 runs from 33 overs in this session and they still have two in-form batters at the crease. The spinners though are getting a lot of turn off the surface and Pakistan's batters will need to be at their very best going ahead.
Quicker, full, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq steps down and blocks it just away from Marnus Labuschagne at silly point. That will be Lunch on Day 5!
Tosses it up, on the pads, fuller ball. Imam-ul-Haq stays back and tries to block this but the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg.
Fuller delivery, slower through the air, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it just away from the fielder at short leg.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq stays in his crease and blocks it out solidly.
Fuller, around off. Imam-ul-Haq defends it out.
Sharp turn and extra bounce again for Lyon! This one lands around middle, turns away. Imam-ul-Haq hangs back and manages to just get a glove onto it just away from the short gully fielder.
Full again, around middle. Babar Azam pushes it back to the bowler.
Full, on middle. Babar Azam leans and defends it out.

Beaten! A beauty by Mitchell Swepson! A fuller ball, loopy one as well, spinning away, outside off. Babar Azam leans to defend this but he gets beaten as the ball turns away from him. A perfect leg-spinner's delivery!
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Babar Azam blocks it out.
Full, on middle. Babar Azam leans and defends it out.
Flighted delivery, full, around off. Imam-ul-Haq has driven this towards long on for a single.
Turning in, around middle, tas shorter. Babar Azam tucks it towards square leg off the back foot.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Babar Azam lunges forward to block this, but the ball goes off the gloves and falls short of the short leg fielder.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Babar Azam defends this one.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Babar Azam blocks it out.
Sharp turn and extra bounce! Fuller, spinning in, around middle. Babar Azam stays back and tries to cut this away, but he manages to fend it away onto the deck.
Full, spinning in, outside off. Babar Azam leans to block this, but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the first slip fielder towards third man. Two taken!
A fuller from 'round the wicket, around off. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it out.
Fullish delivery, tosses it up, on middle. Babar Azam steps down and looks to flick this away, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Loopy delivery, on the pads, very full. Babar Azam tucks it towards square leg.
Full, around middle. Babar Azam defends it out.
Full again, around off, slower through the air. Imam-ul-Haq flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, at around 88.8 clicks, full, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it through covers and takes a single this time. A slight hesitation but they make it comfortably in the end.
Around off. Blocked out.

A mix-up but no harm done in the end. A better throw at the bowler's end and it would have been curtains for Babar Azam. This is tossed up, around off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it towards cover and calls for a run. But he sends back Babar after taking a few steps. Babar Azam is stranded halfway down the pitch. The cover fielder hurls a wayward throw back to Lyon who fails to grab the ball cleanly and Babar makes it safely back inside the crease.
Imam skips down the track and looks to block but it goes off the thick inside edge just past the short leg fielder.
Another ball, flatter and spinning in from outside off. Babar Azam hangs back to block but it goes off the outside edge past the first slip fielder for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off and spinning in late. Babar gets back and dbas it onto the deck.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Imam-ul-Haq gets back in his crease and blocks it.
Short and spinning down leg. Imam-ul-Haq looks to flick but he misses.
An overpitched ball, well outside off. Imam-ul-Haq carves it through the cover region and comes back for the second run.
Floated, full and outside off. Imam keeps it out.
Flatter ball, on middle. Babar Azam tucks it to the leg side and takes a single.
FOUR! A wayward ball from Swepson, a juicy full toss, down leg. Babar Azam tickles it through fine leg and bags a boundary.
Fraction shorter, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it back to Lyon.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq taps it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it out. The ball lobs up and goes just away from the fielder at silly point.
Firing it on the pads, touch fuller. Imam-ul-Haq stays in the crease and tucks it towards square leg.
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Babar Azam leans and drives it past cover for a single.
Spinning in, tad fuller, around off. Babar Azam blocks it out off the back foot.
Flighted delivery, full, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq has defended this one out off the front foot.
On the pads, touch shorter again. Babar Azam flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Babar Azam stays back and cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and leg. Babar Azam leans and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Tad shorter, quicker, around middle. Babar Azam pushes it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Tosses it up, very full, spinning away, outside off. Babar Azam drives it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Mitchell Swepson (5-0-23-0) comes into the attack.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq lunges and looks to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the first slip fielder towards third man. Two taken!
Quicker, full, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq once again advances down the pitch and looks to flick this away, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
Tad shorter, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq dances down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Much fuller now, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it out solidly.
Shorter ball, on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq stays in his crease and tucks it past square leg for a couple of runs.
On a length, shaping away, around middle. Babar Azam blocks it out.
Back of a length this time, on the thigh pad, touch slower on this occasion. Imam-ul-Haq looks to tuck this away, but the ball brushes off his thigh pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Fullish delivery, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and blocks it out solidly.
Good-length delivery, angling in, around middle, at 137 kph. Imam-ul-Haq defends it out.
On a length, shaping away, outside off, at 136.6 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq taps it towards point. No run taken!
A fuller ball from 'round the wicket, outside off, at around 134 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq leans and defends it out.
Shorter in length, outside off. Babar Azam rocks back and punches it to the wide mid off fielder.

Edged but safe! Turn and bounce for Lyon yet again! This ball turns back in sharply, from outside off. Babar Azam prods to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and falls well short of Steven Smith at first slip.
Tossed up, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it wide of the cover fielder and takes a single.
Slower through the air, on a length, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it watchfully off the front foot.
Flighted ball, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out with ease.
Flatter ball, outside off. Babar Azam taps it to the off side for a single.
Short of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it to the off side.
Good-length delivery, around off. Imam-ul-Haq defends it out.
Full and down leg. Imam-ul-Haq misses his flick.
Short of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it and dabs it onto the deck.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Babar Azam tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Babar Azam blocks it out.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq skips down yet again and defends it towards cover.
Imam-ul-Haq runs down the track to this length ball and tries to block it. The ball goes off the thick outside edge towards point.
Flattter ball, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out.
Flighted delivery, on a length, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it off the front foot.
Floated, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq dabs it onto the deck.
Tossed up, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out.
Back of a length, around off. Babar Azam dabs it towards cover.
Good-length, around off. Babar Azam blocks it off the side.
Back of a length, around off. Babar Azam blocks it to the off side.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is full and around middle. Babar Azam prods and caresses it through the mid on region for a boundary. Pakistan's skipper is off the mark in style.
On a good-length, around off. Babar Azam keeps it out.
Back of a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq taps it to cover and takes a single.
Touch fuller, much straighter now, outside off. Babar Azam leans and defends it out.
Sharp turn and extra bounce! Spinning in, around middle. Babar Azam stays in the crease and taps it towards square leg.
Tad quicker, outside off, full again. Babar Azam presses forward and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around off. Babar Azam leans and blocks it out.
Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia opt for a review as they think Azhar Ali has got an inside edge before the ball pops out towards the first slip fielder who grabs it. It turns out to be a successful one for Australia as they get rid of Azhar Ali! Now coming to the ball - Lyon tosses it up, well outside off and spinning in late. Azhar Ali kneels to sweep but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball lobs up towards Steven Smith at first slip and he does the rest. The UltraEdge rolls in and it shows a slight spike. The third umpire asks the on-field umpire to reverse his decision. A huge blow for Pakistan as they lose their second wicket. AUSTRALIA BELIEVE!
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Azhar Ali blocks it out.
Another top delivery by Starc! Another yorker, around off, at 144 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq does well to dig it out. A maiden over from him!
Full again, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq presents the full face of the bat and blocks it out solidly.
Well bowled! Yorker-length delivery now, around middle and off, at around 143 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq digs it out.
Full in length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up again, outside off, tailing in. Imam-ul-Haq defends it back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery, angling in, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it towards mid on.
Slower through the air, full, outside off. Azhar Ali presses forward and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Azhar Ali defends it out.
Fraction short again, outside off. Azhar Ali pushes it towards point off the back foot.

Fuller ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and drives it past cover for a quick single.
Turn and bounce for Lyon! Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Azhar Ali stays in his crease and tucks it towards fine leg for a single.

DRINKS! Pakistan have added 30 runs to their total in the first session so far and both sides would be reasonably happy as the Aussies did manage to get rid of Abdullah Shafique early on. The pitch hasn't played much tricks, but the ball has just started to reverse, so the Pakistani batters would look to bat deep and keep the Aussie bowlers at bay. Also, the first session is going to be an extended one, which means it will go on till 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT).
Very full, tailing back in, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq pushes it towards mid on.
Angling in, around middle, tad fuller. Imam-ul-Haq shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.

On a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq defends it towards cover off the back foot.
Fuller ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Swinging in, tad fuller, on the pads. Imam-ul-Haq flicks it towards square leg. Imam-ul-Haq wanted a single there, but he decides against it in the end, as Azhar Ali wasn't interested to run.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Azhar Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
Touch shorter, outside off. Azhar Ali pushes it past the fielder at silly point.
Spinning in, fuller ball, around off. Azhar Ali defends it out from within the crease.
Quicker through the air, at around 89 clicks, fuller, around off. Azhar Ali leans and blocks it out.
Tad quicker, full, outside off. Azhar Ali gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this but he msses.
Close! A fuller ball, spinning in a tad, outside off. Azhar Ali leans to block but the ball goes off the under edge and it just goes past the off pole.
Down the leg side, on a length. Imam-ul-Haq looks to tuck this but he misses.
Full now, outside off, at 144.3 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Better from Starc! This one was an outswinger, on a length, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq defends it out watchfully.
An inswinger, on the pads, fuller length. Imam-ul-Haq flicks it past square leg for a brace.
Another length delivery from over the wicket to the left-hander, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it out watchfully.

Mitchell Starc serves a length ball from 'round the wicket, angling in, around middle, at around 139 clicks. Azhar Ali looks to block this but the ball goes off the outside half of the bat, away from the fielder at gully towards third man. Single taken!
Slower through the air, full and on middle. Imam-ul-Haq covers the line and blocks it with ease.

Nicely played! Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq hangs back and guides it past the short third man fielder for a brace. 100 comes up for Pakistan! They require 251 more runs to win this Test as well as the series.
Flighted delivery, around off. Imam-ul-Haq stretches forward and defends it. Not much spin for Lyon so far!
Lyon goes wide of the crease and serves it on a length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq dabs it onto the deck.
Floated, full and on middle. Imam-ul-Haq defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around off. Imam-ul-Haq gets forward and keeps it out.
Good-length delivery, around off. Azhar Ali blocks it with ease. 9 runs off the over!

Ali looks to sway his bat away from the line but in the end, manages to run it down past the slip cordon and into the fence. He made sure that he does not push hard at the ball and played it with soft hands.
Crunched but for no run! Another ball, full and outside off. Azhar Ali drives but Usman Khawaja at short cover dives to his left and stops it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A half-volley, outside off from 'round the wicket. Azhar Ali prods and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.

FIFTY for Imam-ul-Haq! Another gritty innings by the Pakistani opener! This is a full ball, around leg. Imam glances it to fine leg and rotates the strike. Imam though would be aware that the job is only half done as Pakistan have a long way to go.
Starc starts with a wayward ball, angling down leg. Imam misses his flick and once again, Alex Carey has to make a diving stop behind the sticks.
Mitchell Starc (5-2-9-0) comes to bowl now.
Floated, full and outside off. Azhar Ali smothers the spin and blocks it.

Turn and bounce for Lyon! This is pitched way outside off. Azhar Ali looks to work it to the leg side with hard hands but the ball spins sharply and it goes off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Flighted delivery, around off. Ali defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam pushes it to mid on and scampers through to the other end. The fielder at mid on misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Floated, full and around off. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out.

Lyon tosses it up, well outside off. Azhar Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through the cover region. The ball doesn't have enough legs to race away to the ropes. Pat Cummins cuts it off and the batters collect three runs.
It's time for spin! Nathan Lyon (9-2-23-0) comes into the attack.
Back of a length, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket. Not in the gap though. Another maiden over from Cameron Green!
Drags his length back a bit, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq hops in his crease and tucks it to square leg.
Green changes his angle and goes over the wicket. He hurls a full ball, on middle. Imam leans and drives it to the mid on fielder.
A length ball, jagging back in from middle. Imam-ul-Haq stays back and wrists it to mid-wicket.
A bumper, angling down leg. Imam-ul-Haq ducks underneath.
Green comes 'round the wicket and serves it on a length, around off. Imam gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it to the on side.
A length ball, jagging back in from off. Azhar Ali gets forward and defends it.
A short ball, around leg. Azhar Ali hangs back and tickles it to backward square leg.
Full and on middle. Azhar Ali drives but straight to the mid on fielder.

Good-length ball, around the fifth stump channel. Azhar Ali skips down a bit and just guides it through the third man region. Mitchell Swepson gives it a chase and keeps it to just two. Good cricket all around.
On a length, around off. Azhar Ali keeps it out, off the front foot.
This is a full ball, angling in from off. Azhar Ali gets forward and pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length, down leg. Azhar Ali tucks it towards fine leg for a single. He will keep strike for the next over!
Length delivery, angling in, around off. Azhar Ali leans to defend this but he gets an inside edge on the pads. Cameron Green though appeals for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq flicks it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. A slight fumble there allows the batters to complete the run comfortably.
Touch fuller, angling in, around off. Imam-ul-Haq prods and blocks it out.
Down the leg side, length delivery. Imam-ul-Haq misses his flick.
Swinging in, around middle, on a length, at 133.3 clicks. Imam-ul-Haq blocks it out.
Another length delivery, around middle. Azhar Ali shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, around off, tailing in. Azhar Ali blocks it out towards point.
